documents.text: Keith Butler (American football) John Keith Butler (born May 16, 1956) is an American football coach who is the defensive coordinator of the Pittsburgh Steelers of the National Football League (NFL). He played for the NFL's Seattle Seahawks for ten years and retired after the 1987 season. Butler played college football at Memphis State University (University of Memphis since 1994), starting for three years at inside linebacker under head coach Richard Williamson.
